correctness.rationale: For arbitrary distinct row nodes the Hermitian quartic restrictions share top coefficients c and 2w. Four zeros force each restriction to equal c times the associated monic root polynomial. Unequal row sums force c=0 and kernel span H_h with det 2; no rank≤2 element. Equal sums permit an independent c=1 kernel, and det(K1+tH_h) is a real cubic with leading coefficient 2, so a nonzero rank-two indefinite kernel exists. Semidefinite rank≤2 members cannot annihilate four Vandermonde evaluation vectors. The exact checker passed six geometry cases and the universal kernel identities.
